id: title:adboio:publish compute rate card v1 effective 2026 08 21

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a new pricing tier configuration and its validation, potentially relevant to warehouse billing or tiered compute pricing, though no live customer ingestion or runtime enforcement is demonstrated.
review.reason: The change introduces a new v1 ComputeRateCard with a fixed future effective date and a corresponding validation test. This represents a substantive, bounded capability addition: defining a pricing tier and checking its validity. However, the implementation uses a hardcoded future date and lacks runtime scheduling, warehouse dependency, or live customer impact, preventing a tier 3.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether this configuration is consumed by warehouse billing or tiered pricing, which is not demonstrated in the supplied hunks. No runtime behavior or customer-facing change is shown.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned. No adoption, incident, or benefit inferred. No tier assigned.
